description: This Java test class 'ServiceContextTest' verifies the behavior of the 'ServiceContext' class in the OpenMRS project, focusing on its methods related to module service loading and exception handling under various scenarios.

classes.name: ServiceContextTest
classes.description: A JUnit Jupiter test class extending OpenMRS's BaseContextSensitiveTest, testing the behavior of ServiceContext methods related to module service setup and exception handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the testing environment before each test, initializing mocks, obtaining the ServiceContext instance, and creating a spy object.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Restores the original ServiceContext state after each test.

methods.name: getModuleOpenmrsServices_shouldRaiseApiExceptionWithNonExistentClass
methods.description: Tests that 'setModuleService' throws an APIException when given a non-existent class name.

methods.name: getModuleOpenmrsServices_shouldRaiseApiExceptionWithNullClass
methods.description: Tests that 'setModuleService' throws an APIException when the class name provided is null.

methods.name: getModuleOpenmrsServices_shouldRaiseApiExceptionWithNullClassInstance
methods.description: Tests that 'setModuleService' throws an APIException when the class name is valid but the class instance is null.
